operating_notes.text: Madras High Court set aside a ₹3.63 Cr Section 271(1)(c) penalty order on Rane Steering Systems for AY 2015-16 and remitted the case to the Assessment Unit for a fresh order.
RML agreed to sell 3.48 acres of land in Velachery for ₹361.18 Cr, receiving ₹145 Cr advance by March 31, 2026.
Rane Group aggregate sales stood at ₹8,414 Cr in FY26 (~USD 955 Mn).
Rane (Madras) secured orders worth ₹33 Cr per annum including ₹3 Cr from international customers.
Joint ventures won orders worth ₹55 Cr per annum for occupant safety products from domestic customers.

CRISIL rated total bank loan facilities of ₹110 Cr, comprising ₹81.84 Cr proposed term loan, ₹5 Cr proposed working capital, ₹18.16 Cr term loan from Bajaj Finance and ₹5 Cr working capital demand loan from HDFC Bank.
Rane Holdings approved further investment of ₹80.85 Cr in JV ZF Lifetec Rane Automotive India Private Limited

timeline.summary: May 4, 2026: Madras High Court set aside the ₹3.63 Cr Section 271(1)(c) penalty order on Rane Steering Systems for AY 2015-16 and remitted the case to the Assessment Unit for a fresh order.
May 15, 2026: Board approved preferential issue of 3,38,030 warrants at ₹1,183.32 each to promoters raising up to ₹40 Cr and recommended ₹47/share dividend.
Rane Holdings Limited’s Board declared final dividend payment date as August 24, 2026, per Siva Chandrasekaran’s May 15, 2026 filing.
May 15, 2026: Released Q4 & FY26 earnings presentation reporting FY26 revenue of ₹5,907.2 Cr and Q4 PAT of ₹87.5 Cr.
L Ganesh, on behalf of Rane Holdings Limited’s promoter group, declared no encumbrances on shares under SEBI’s Regulation 31(4) as of April 07, 2026.

Rane Holdings Limited’s **Subha Shree**, Secretary, scheduled an in-person analyst meet with Unique Asset Management LLP and NV Alpha Fund Management LLP on June 11, 2026, at 14:00 and 15:30 hrs in Chennai.
CRISIL assigned CRISIL AA-/Stable to ₹105 Cr long-term and CRISIL A1+ to ₹5 Cr short-term bank facilities of Rane Holdings, totalling ₹110 Cr.
2026-10-22: Rane Holdings approved ₹80.85 Cr investment in JV ZF Lifetec Rane Automotive to maintain 49% stake
